content:
From template-modernization-tickets.md trailing section. The `carnegie` repo (~/workspace/wack/carnegie) needs the same diffs as TPL-001/002/004/006/007/008/009/013, PLUS two regressions unique to it:

- Restore Docker OTel provenance build-args: its build-push-action step passes no build-args, so images carry none of the VCS_REF_* / CICD_PIPELINE_* attributes.
- Add a top-level build.rs (+ vergen-gitcl build-dependency): it has only a `fn main(){}` stub and stamps no provenance.
- Also: complete its thin .story/, add an OPENTELEMETRY.md, and wire a cucumber harness for its orphaned spec/*.feature files.

Back-port FROM carnegie: its "# Carnegie Overview" service-purpose intro paragraph is the kind of intro the template's CLAUDE.md lacks (TPL-010 / T-010) — steal the idea.

Tracking this here only for traceability; carnegie work belongs in carnegie's own .story/.
title: Carnegie parity work (separate repo — out of scope here)
